name: dale
description: One-on-one brainstorming, repository indexing, adaptive task graphs, and standalone HTML visualization for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Dale supports focused brainstorming, evidence-backed repository primitives, adaptive graphs of visible Codex tasks, and self-contained HTML visualizations selected from task-relevant patterns.
